title: La mejor app de selfcare
body: Si eres neurodivergente o te cuesta trabajo cumplir con rutinas o metas diarias esta app es para ti. Te dan un pajarito y cada día tiene una aventura diferente. Es una app pensada en sus usuarios 🤍 está en inglés así que es una buena opción para reforzar el idioma. La versión gratuita es muy buena. La app se mantiene actualizada y con constantes iteraciones, la experiencia de usuario es buena. He probado muchas apps pero son tediosas o aburridas de usar y Finch es la única que continúo usando y con la que doy seguimiento a mi salud física y mental 🤍 tkm Finch

title: Ruined in last update
body: This was the best cutest app ever for self care and daily goals.  Now they redesigned the whole thing and the bird is gigantic and it all looks really ugly.  Not cute at all. Lost inspiration to use and looking for an alternative. Shame because it really made me keep track of habits and tasks for more than 6 months. I have the paid version. I don't get why devs just keep on altering things that worked and looked fine before. A bird that is 20 feet tall, disproportionate and above the trees is not cute, is almost scary. The idea was to do a goal/task and get 'points' (stones) to get items for the bird, and without that gamifying part, it makes no sense to me to keep or use. Very disappointed.

title: One of the best mental health apps
body:
Finch  has helped me a lot, naming her and seeing her grow really helps you achieve your goals.
The free version is full, you don’t have to pay to get help. Of course there’s some things cool in the pay version but you can still have fun and improve! I would pay to help the creators lol 
My favorite part is when ever you tell your penguin that you’re felling bad they give you a SOS kit, includes grounding exercises, breathing exercises, and positive exercises.
I’ve had it for a month and it has really helped me. ♥️
